online_feature_time: after current sensor/odometry arrival, before any current GICP outcome; state from past admitted factors only
scheduler: frozen timestamp-normalized deterministic events; no future descriptor/state/outcome; freeze eligibility and splits before selector work
P0: unchanged frozen full rank-ordered Top3 reference
P3: unchanged Stage22B SC confidence baseline; original normalization and threshold
P5: unchanged Stage22B C75/B80 reference; no hindsight re-selection
P6_INFO: p_hat_GICP * 0.5logdet(I6 + R_nom^-1/2 J_pred C_pair_past J_pred.T R_nom^-1/2) divided by exact marginal request bytes (minimum positive framing cost); include compute cap separately
P6_COVER: causal odometry arc-length endpoint facility-location marginal coverage per marginal byte; no GT or future trajectory
P6_HYBRID: fixed nonnegative combination of predicted information, odometry coverage and regional graph connectivity; predeclared development-only calibration; shared resource caps
P7_TIAN: Tian-inspired resource-aware budgeted submodular greedy comparison over a frozen arrived-only snapshot, verification-edge count and shared observation-upload bytes; not a claimed exact theorem-certified reproduction of the original algorithm
p_hat: optional calibrated geometric-quality acceptance probability trained only on genuinely independent development actual GICP outcomes; not GT physical correctness and not unmeasured outcome imputation
pre_bridge: cross-component connectivity mode; no invertible joint common-frame covariance is claimed before a bridge. Use a separately frozen SC-confidence/cost bridge rule, never a future optimized transform.
post_bridge: current causal ISAM2 prefix pose/covariance plus propagated arriving odometry node. Predict Z from causal poses and frozen SC yaw hypothesis; nominal noise fixed. Never insert measured current-GICP Z into pre-GICP features.
coverage_formula: F_cov(S)=sum over currently arrived robot/path anchors u of w_u * max_{e in S} exp(-abs(s_u-s_endpoint(e))/ell_robot); s from nonGT local odometry; anchor spacing/kernel scales frozen on development without GT
connectivity: component reduction in currently available robot/odometry-region graph; region coverage distinct from global graph connectivity
cost: same serializer and cache semantics as baseline; exact marginal cloud-request union including framing/cache eviction; RingKey bytes alone are not total bytes
theorem_caveat: monotone logdet of fixed PSD contributions and fixed-universe facility location can be submodular. Evolving posterior covariance, relinearization, robust weights, finite-cache costs and streaming deadlines do not automatically preserve a cited approximation guarantee. Review original pseudocode and prove equivalence before using guarantee language.
selection_tie_break: deterministic event/rank/original IDs, frozen before future execution
unknown_rank_rule: new real GICP required when selected; 2112 unknown ranks are never inferred from SC/GT/neighbors
